Julia Letlow is now a big favorite to win the Louisiana senate seat currently held by Bill Cassidy. Voting is taking place today. I’ve stopped looking at polls and almost exclusively check Polymarket & Kalshi for political races.

Money has poured in on @DerekDooley in past few weeks to win Georgia Republican senate nomination. He’s now favored on Kalshi & a small underdog on Polymarket. Georgia primary is Tuesday. Democrat John Ossoff believes men should be able to play women’s sports. Bad fit for GA.

A one time transfer rule would end perpetual free agency, if combined with a legit salary cap then many of the issues facing college athletics would be fixed. Right now college basketball is the second highest paying league in the world! European pros are coming to play CBB here.

Ultimately what has to happen is Congress MUST pass an antitrust exemption for college athletics to allow basic rule implementation. The most important first rule? Ending unlimited transfers. Players shouldn’t be able to play for five different teams in five years. That’s insane.

The biggest issue facing college football isn’t playoff size, however, it’s cost. Without a salary cap college athletics is going to collapse. The math doesn’t add up to pay massive salaries to college football & men’s basketball players and keep all the non-revenue sports too.

I do think three things should happen: 1. Conference title games make zero sense. They should be eliminated. 2. The season should end much sooner. 3. Every team with a legit shot at a title should make the playoff. The current 12 team system fails all three of these tests.

I will never complain about there being too many college football playoff games because I spent the first twenty years of my college football fandom begging for there to be any playoff at all. 4, 8, 12, 16, 24 teams, I’ll take any of it.
